## Description and Rationale

Airline pilot  and hobby programmer, competing as an
individual. Taxi-out is something I deal with operationally on every
departure, so I wanted to see how much of that first-hand intuition — stand
position, runway in use, departure banks, de-icing — actually holds up against
the data. First data challenge for me. Code will be published on GitHub under
GPLv3.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Czech Republic
* Number of team members: 1
